items.heading: Vocational and Skill Courses After
items.text: Vocational and skill courses after 12th train you for a trade or technical role in a shorter time. Examples include ITI-style trades where eligible, diplomas, skill council courses and apprenticeships.

items.heading: Look for Courses Linked
items.text: Look for courses linked to recognised bodies and employers. Check government skill and apprenticeship portals for current schemes and eligibility, because details change.
